shared_brief: Create an editable portrait invitation template. Keep headline, names, date, time, venue and RSVP as separate editable text elements. Use the stated visual direction and palette. Preserve strong text contrast, generous padding, and clear hierarchy. Use only original decorative shapes and illustrations. Use literal placeholder text, never real event details. Do not add payment instructions, QR codes, URLs, logos, copyrighted characters, or filler prose.
notes: The eight categories come from originalTemplates and stationeryTemplates aggregated by catalog.ts. imported-templates.json is empty.
Allocation gives the broad Wedding and Everyday categories 18 each; Birthday 14; Baby and Celebration 12 each; Graduation 10; Remembrance and Thanks 8 each.
All 17 public occasion choices in src/modules/events/occasions.ts are represented; additional supported eventTypes provide suitable gatherings for broad categories.
Thanks is expressed as invitations to appreciation gatherings; Remembrance uses respectful invitations without invented memories.
No production catalogue imports or licensing attestations are implied by these briefs.
